ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the Cartesian coordinate system, $O$ is the origin, and point $A(3, 3)$ is on the graph of the inverse proportional function $y = \frac{k}{x}$. What is the value of $k$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since the point $A(3, 3)$ lies on the graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{k}{x}$, \\
it follows that $k=3\times 3=\boxed{9}$
